The players' Fiad 131 (F10): 3D model, textures and sounds by Rallyworld, lent for free with their permission. Converted for the game.
Every player can have their own rally Fiad 131, free: F10 > Fiad 131 tab. Sixteen colours, one per player; the colour also gives the number painted on the doors.
Pick a free colour then Take: the car appears next to you, for everyone.
Bring here (or V): brings it back next to you, if nobody is driving it.
Give back: it disappears and its colour is free again. It also disappears when you leave the game: when you come back, or after loading, take one again in F10.
Can be turned off like the other add-ons: Settings > Co-op > MWCoop additions (the host's choice applies to everyone). 3D model by Rallyworld (Guide > Credits).
